_note: Non-custodial exchange + self-serve-listing fee treasury. These are PUBLIC receiving addresses — the 0.1% swap protocol fee, the $5/asset + $1/extra-pair listing fees, and the 0.05% in-wallet-agent trade fee are paid here on-chain. No private keys live here or anywhere in the repo. MAINNET addresses: only used when mainnet_enabled=true; provide separate testnet addresses for dev.
_agentFeeNote: 0.05% (5 bps) is skimmed from EVERY trade the in-wallet AI agent executes (any venue: Blockle AMM/exchange, Uniswap/1inch/0x, Jupiter, etc.) and sent on-chain to the treasury address for that trade's chain — EVM/Base/ERC20 -> the 'base'/'ethereum' address, Solana -> the 'solana' address. Logged in the agent audit log.

testnet._blockNote: block = testnet/dev BLOCK fee sink (genesis dev wallet, NOT a mainnet receiving address). Required so a native BLOCK agent swap can route its 0.05% fee on the block chain when mainnet_enabled=false (the default).
